lines.en: I drift over, patch by patch.
My wings are thin, almost clear.
I float slowly in the hot air.
I settle on a patch of ash.
I don't fly high. I stay low.

lines.zh: 我顺着上升的热气盘旋。
lines.en: I circle on the rising heat.
The wind nudges me.
I fly low, hugging the rock wall.
I ride the current up.
I settle, then lift again.
I drift slowly through the gap.
I barely beat my wings.

lines.zh: 我在红光照到的地方飞。
lines.en: I fly where the red light falls.
Patch by patch, I go forward.
I steer clear of the flames.
I circle under the cavern roof.
I rest on the rock face.
My wings are half closed.
I beat them twice.
The heat here doesn't hurt.
I can't see far.

lines.zh: 我在热气里慢慢飘，翅几乎透光。
lines.en: I drift in the heat, wings almost transparent.
Nothing to hurry to.
My colors are faint.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头不动，地狱的灰落满翅膀。
lines.en: I cling to the stone; hell ash covers my wings.

lines.zh: 热灰把我的翅染成土色。
lines.en: Hot ash stains my wings the color of earth.
I spread my wings on the hot stone.

lines.zh: 我停在冷却的岩浆壳上。
lines.en: I rest on a cooled crust of lava.
You're bigger than this whole rock.
My wings are too thin to survive a touch.
One touch and my wings tear.

lines.zh: 你手指的影子盖住了我。
lines.en: The shadow of your finger covers me.
I've never seen your like.

lines.zh: 你伸过来的手指太大了。
lines.en: The fingers you reach out with are far too big.
I'm only drifting about.
One breath from you and I drift backward.
There is only a thin coat of ash on me.
Are you about to step on me?

lines.zh: 我抖了两下翅膀，飞不起来。
lines.en: I shake my wings twice and cannot rise.
I lost my balance in the air.

lines.zh: 落在地上，翅上的火没灭。
lines.en: Down on the ground, the fire on my wings stays.
Light, and brittle.
I fluttered twice.
That much could finish me.
My dust came off.

lines.zh: 地狱的蝴蝶，翅上有火色。
lines.en: Hell butterfly wings, fire-colored.
I can barely crawl.
You hardly tried.
That in your hand is far too big.

lines.zh: 我的翅一扇，热的灰就散开。
lines.en: One beat of my wings scatters hot ash.
There is no smell of nectar on your hands.
A hell butterfly, wings covered in ash.
Hold that bit of sweetness lower.
I don't much want to eat.
Your hands are too rough.
I don't know that smell.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀，带着地狱的热。
lines.en: My wings carry the heat of hell.
Best if I move along.
One touch and I'm off course.
Nether fire lights my wings.

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到我的翅膀。
lines.en: Your finger brushed my wing.
Your sleeve rolls me over.
I can't push you away.
The ash got stirred up.
I landed on your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我一碰就偏，落到你袖上。
lines.en: One touch tilts me onto your sleeve.
I nearly dropped.
My wings are a little scrap of fire.
We circle in the hot air.
Our wings touched.
We're both very light.
Don't stand under us.
It's darker than I am.
We circled three times.
Afterwards we drift apart.
Nothing will come of this.
Ash settled over us.
Neither of us stirred a wing.
I settle on the thing.
I can't move it.
I grip it with my legs.
That thing in the ash tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 我卷起口器去够那点甜。
lines.en: I unroll my proboscis for that bit of sweetness.

lines.zh: 地狱蝴蝶这么小，它比我还大。
lines.en: A hell butterfly is small. That thing is bigger.
I landed and took off again.
What you dropped is on the ash.
That is not nectar.

lines.zh: 我六条腿抱不住这块石头。
lines.en: My six legs cannot get around this stone.
Your movement frightens me.
I'll hide higher up.
I settle on the dead ash and play dead.
The ash is too thin here.
I fly toward the dark.
Don't follow me.
I only want to get out of the way.
My wings are trembling.
There are no flowers here.
I slip into the crack.
I make for the cavern roof.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以躲的地方。
lines.en: There's nowhere to hide here.
I climb the rock face.

lines.zh: 我数着灰上落下的脚步。
lines.en: I count the footsteps landing in the ash.
I rest in the dark.
I don't want to be seen.
I edge along bit by bit.
You're right below me.
My color matches the stone.

lines.zh: 我的翅是灰的，像烧过的纸。
lines.en: My wings are grey as burnt paper.
I settle into the ash.
The heat is weaker here.
I circle behind the pillar.
It's darker under the ash.
My wing sweeps across your face.
That barely counts as a blow.
It left me dizzy instead.
You hardly felt it.
I brush your hand with the tip of my wing.
I gnaw at your knuckle.
That wouldn't frighten anything.
I withdrew at once.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，翅粉撒了你一手。
lines.en: I fly at you and dust your hand with wing powder.
I shouldn't have come near.
I rise out of the ash.
My wings caught light first.
I settle on the stone.
There's not much here in bloom.
I'm covered in ash.
I drifted over from the hot side.
Two beats and I stopped.
Red light everywhere.
I'm looking for somewhere to hide.
I opened my wings slowly.

lines.zh: 火苗碰了一下，翅膀就卷了。
lines.en: Fire touched a wing and it curled.
I fell and landed in the ash.

lines.zh: 这里不会有水，可我被淹了。
lines.en: There shouldn't be water, but I'm drowning.

lines.zh: 爆炸的热浪把我掀到半空。
lines.en: The blast's hot wind throws me into the air.
The arrow went between my wings.
That light numbed my wings.
No nectar and I can't last.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的颜色都没了。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my color went.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有热气可以借。
lines.en: No hot air to ride in the void.
